title: Puppy reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Puppy body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- Chest lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#F0C27A'/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='18' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- Head lighter patch -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='11' fill='#F0C27A'/>
  
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='28' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-20 32 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='28' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(20 68 28)'/>
  <!-- Inner ears -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='29' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#D4A06A' transform='rotate(-20 33 29)'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='29' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#D4A06A' transform='rotate(20 67 29)'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='32' r='4' fill='#4A3728'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='32' r='4' fill='#4A3728'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='30.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='30.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#4A3728'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='39' rx='1.2' ry='1' fill='#7A6355'/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46 44 Q50 48 54 44' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='43' x2='50' y2='46' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  
  <!-- Tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='47' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#FF7B8A'/>
  
  <!-- Book - outside cover -->
  <rect x='22' y='62' width='56' height='22' rx='2' fill='#E8453C'/>
  <!-- Book pages -->
  <rect x='25' y='64' width='25' height='18' rx='1' fill='#FFF8EC'/>
  <rect x='50' y='64' width='25' height='18' rx='1' fill='#FFF8EC'/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='50' y2='84' stroke='#B03028' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Book text lines -->
  <line x1='29' y1='69' x2='47' y2='69' stroke='#D0C8B8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='29' y1='73' x2='45' y2='73' stroke='#D0C8B8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='29' y1='77' x2='46' y2='77' stroke='#D0C8B8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='69' x2='71' y2='69' stroke='#D0C8B8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='73' x2='69' y2='73' stroke='#D0C8B8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='77' x2='70' y2='77' stroke='#D0C8B8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  
  <!-- Paws holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='80' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#C68642'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='80' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- Paw pads -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='79' r='2' fill='#F0C27A'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='79' r='2' fill='#F0C27A'/>
  
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M72 75 Q85 70 82 58' stroke='#C68642' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M72 75 Q85 70 82 58' stroke='#F0C27A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Freckles -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='40' r='1' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='42' r='1' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='40' r='1' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='42' r='1' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
</svg>
